doctrine: Missing evidence remains UNKNOWN. FINAL_SUPER_GREEN is forbidden unless every mandatory gate and the authoritative submission deadline are resolved from current DCE evidence. Non-solicitations, already-awarded/single-source notices, hard foreign/security restrictions and obvious non-SPM scopes are rejected. Brokerable commodity supply may remain YELLOW when a supplier route is plausible but bidder proof is unresolved.

results.title: Defense Logistics Information Research (DLIR)
blockers: Retrieved authoritative material repeatedly states a 2021 BAA closing date while the live notice metadata says 2026-09-01; current submission authority is not reconciled.
The BAA is defense logistics R&D with technical/scientific review, detailed cost realism, DCAA/accounting representations and research-team expectations rather than a lean SPM service procurement.
Relevant prior research, technical papers, key personnel and detailed cost structure are integral to evaluation.
results.why: Interesting AI/RPA language produced a semantic false positive, but the current DCE evidence is both temporally conflicted and qualification-heavy defense R&D.

results.title: R--Region 6 Superfund Technical Assessment and Response Team (START) IV
blockers: The recovered DCE is a bridge justification for other than full and open competition covering July 2023-January 2024, not a current open competitive solicitation.
Mission scope is EPA Superfund emergency technical assessment/response, not SPM's lean digital/creative/broker core.
results.why: The hot queue treated substantive historical acquisition paperwork as live bid evidence.

results.title: ULTRA-BROADBAND TERAHERTZ RADIO DEVELOPMENT
blockers: Advanced terahertz radio hardware/R&D program is not a lean SPM delivery scope.
DCE states the BAA is closed to foreign participation except limited fundamental-research exceptions and contains foreign-national/FOCI controls.
Security-risk review, senior/key-person disclosures and scientific/technical capability are material requirements.
results.why: A live open BAA, but fundamentally the wrong bidder and technical profile for SPM.

results.title: BPA - Pipe, Hose & Tubing PSC 4710, 4720, 4730
unknowns: Authoritative current submission timing is not resolved from the recovered DCE.
SPM has not evidenced relevant federal past performance or a compliant pipe/hose/tubing supplier route.
Domestic-content/origin and other federal supply clauses require item-level supplier validation.
results.why: Not a native SPM service, but unlike the other hot items it is potentially brokerable commodity supply. Keep only as a supplier/middleman investigation, not as a GREEN bid.

results.title: Vendor Collaboration - MULTI-CENTER CLINICAL TRIALS OF NOVEL THERAPIES FOR PATIENTS WITH WELL CHARACTERIZED GASTROPARESIS
blockers: The DCE explicitly says this is not a procurement contract or grant for goods/services and that NIDDK provides no funds to selected collaborators.
It seeks clinical-research collaborators contributing therapeutic agents, devices, laboratory capability and research funding/resources.
results.why: Not a revenue tender at all; it is a clinical research collaboration opportunity.

results.title: J065--Zeiss Microscope Maintenance - NWI
blockers: Authoritative justification says maintenance must be performed by Zeiss-certified field engineers and identifies PROAIM as the only authorized Zeiss representative accepted for service/repair labor.
Recovered award material names PROAIM AMERICAS, LLC as awardee on 2026-08-14.
results.why: Already-awarded/single-source manufacturer-authorized maintenance, not a live SPM opportunity.

results.title: Patient lifts and Installation
blockers: DCE is an only-one-responsible-source restricted-competition justification for Guldmann patient-lift equipment and installation.
Scope requires medical patient-lift hardware, structural installation/load testing and safe-patient-handling compliance, not SPM's lean core.
results.why: Medical equipment installation plus restricted-source procurement; not realistically executable by SPM as prime.

results.title: Jamaica Strategic Public Sector Transformation
blockers: Recovered material is broad project/procurement-plan context for a World Bank-financed public-sector transformation program, not a specific currently actionable solicitation with a submission deadline.
No specific SPM-fit deliverable, bidder gate set or submission package is established in the evidence.
results.why: Project-level procurement context was incorrectly promoted as a bid-ready tender.

results.title: Explosive Trace Detection (ETD) Qualified Products List (QPL)
blockers: Applicant must provide production-representative explosive-trace-detection systems meeting TSA detection/functional standards and pass certification/qualification testing.
DCE contains classified/SSI handling, facility/personnel clearance and DD Form 254 requirements where applicable.
This is specialized security-screening hardware qualification, not an SPM service or brokerable generic supply tender.
results.why: Hard technical/security qualification makes this an obvious false positive.

results.title: One Acquisition Solution for Integrated Services Plus (OASIS+) Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) Set-Aside Continuously Open Solicitation
blockers: This vehicle is explicitly an SDVOSB set-aside and requires qualification under that program for prime award.
The DCE contains extensive scored qualification, cybersecurity/supply-chain, reporting and contract-vehicle requirements well beyond a lean one-off SPM tender.
unknowns: No evidence in the tender-engine bidder profile establishes SPM as an eligible SDVOSB prime.
results.why: Potentially broad services, but the mandatory socioeconomic vehicle gate and heavy IDIQ qualification make it non-actionable for SPM on current evidence.

learning_signals: Already-awarded and single-source justification documents must be rejected before user-facing GPT final review.
Project notices and no-funding collaboration opportunities must never enter the revenue-tender final-review inbox.
Foreign-participation, socioeconomic set-aside, specialized hardware/security and medical-equipment gates need stronger post-DCE rejection signals.
Commodity BPAs may remain YELLOW for broker investigation, but must not be promoted GREEN without a compliant supplier route, bidder evidence and authoritative submission timing.
